name: Eaton
outlook:
What Eaton says to expect

  • Fourth quarter 2026: guidanceFor the fourth quarter of 2026, the company anticipates: • Organic growth of 13-15% • Segment margins of 25.4-25.8% • Earnings per share between $3.28 and $3.38 • Adjusted earnings per share between $4.05 and $4.15
  • Full year 2026: guidanceFor the full year 2026, the company anticipates: • Organic growth of 13-15% • Segment margins of 24.1-24.5% • Earnings per share between $10.39 and $10.49 • Adjusted earnings per share between $13.70 and $13.80
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 3, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
